attr.title: ONScripter-Yuri
attr.desc: ONScripter-Yuri is an enhanced ONScripter, an open source engine for NScripter visual novels, with Lua scripting and Shift-JIS, GBK and UTF-8 scripts.
attr.inst: Copy each NScripter game (0.txt, 00.txt or nscript.dat plus its .nsa/.sar archives) into its own folder in ports/onsyuri/games/, then pick it in the launcher.
